    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--replay', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    r = Robot()
    status = r.status()
    if not args.replay:
        print(json.dumps(status, indent=2))
        return
    if status.get('control_steps', 0) != 0:

    history = json.loads((root / 'history.json').read_text())

                dt=0.05, cameras=['canvas_cam', 'practice_cam'], video='none',

            # Never guess whether a permanent-ink command ran.
            raise RuntimeError(f'Action {index} needs reconciliation: {before=} {after=}')
